notes: the first chain is the main route; the three later chains carry the saying in other wording or through another transmitter and are marked variant (rule 4)
whether each later chain is the same saying is not settled by the rules (different Companions and wording); ruling needed
the two «خالد» in the third chain are kept as two links (rule 7, rule 9); the head of the fourth chain (after «تابعه») is not written, so only Hisham's route is read
